name: Stagger Toggle Switches
description: Row of striped checkbox toggle switches whose bars slide across the rail with staggered GSAP elastic or glitchy rough easing, with glow on active and focus.
contents: Row of labeled toggle switches, each a striped rail with a bar stack that slides on toggle
behavior: Checking or unchecking slides each bar across the rail with a stagger, in random or sequential order
Elastic or rough ease is chosen per switch
Border and glow change on checked and keyboard focus
editableByProps: Number of switches, labels, ids, durations, stagger, ease type and order
Rail size, bar rows, travel distance
All stripe, bar, border, glow and label colors

needsCodeEdit.where: rect elements inside the g.switch group

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Each switch id must be unique and is used as a DOM selector
Travel distance should match rail width minus bar width and margins
